result.planSummary: Implemented minimal lower-band awareness in the workbench query layer by adding chunk-detail reads and lower-band readiness inspection backed by optional chunk metadata, while keeping upper-band inspection independent from incomplete chunk data. Added the Story 5 query-service coverage for chunk-based lower-band selections, open-chunk ineligibility, closed-chunk readiness, minimal chunk detail, and upper-band resilience.

changedFiles.reason: Added chunk-reader support plus openChunkDetail and inspectLowerBandReadiness query APIs with lower-band eligibility logic based on chunk lifecycle and summary artifacts.
Added Story 5 fixtures and 8 query-service tests covering lower-band chunk selections, readiness states, minimal chunk detail, and upper-band inspection when chunk data is incomplete.

findingsFixed: Adjusted the chunk-detail test to verify the minimal reader-oriented surface without overfitting to optional undefined fields present on the chunk read shape.
findingsSurfaced: `npm run green-verify` fails only because `guard:no-test-changes` rejects the modified story test file, even though unit, integration, and e2e verification all pass.

result.recommendedNextStep: Take a human ruling on the expected `guard:no-test-changes` failure for the modified story test file, then proceed with story verification using the passing `npm run verify-all` evidence.
